fields.label: Enable Online Payments
fields.description: Students and parents can pay dues from the portal. Collections settle directly to the institution's merchant account.

fields.label: Payment Gateway
fields.description: Gateway for new payments. Payments already started are confirmed by the gateway that took them, so keep the old gateway's keys until its payments are settled.

fields.label: Test Mode
fields.description: Use the gateway's test credentials (Razorpay rzp_test_... keys, PayU test merchant). No real money is collected, so only the test payers below can pay.

fields.label: Merchant Display Name
fields.description: Shown on the payment page, e.g. "ACGCET Hostels".

fields.label: Transaction Expiry (Minutes)
fields.description: Unpaid online transactions are marked Expired after this time and their invoices become payable again.

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Secret entered while creating the webhook in the Razorpay dashboard.

fields.label: Merchant Key
fields.description: From PayU Dashboard > Developers > Key and Salt.

fields.label: Merchant Salt
fields.description: Salt (version 1). Used to sign payment forms and to verify PayU's responses and webhooks.

fields.label: Test Payers
fields.description: While Test Mode is on, only these students can pay online, so test payments never clear real students' dues.

fields.label: Send Fee Reminders
fields.description: Daily at 08:00, students and parents are reminded of dues falling due soon or overdue.

fields.label: Days Between Reminders
fields.description: A family is reminded at most once in this many days, with one message covering all their dues.

fields.label: Maximum Reminders per Invoice
fields.description: Reminders stop after this many for an invoice. 0 means no limit.
